title: Bel Canto
author: Ann Patchett
summary: At a birthday party in an unnamed South American country, terrorists seize the vice president's house and take the guests hostage, including a famed opera singer. Weeks pass and the captives and captors form unlikely bonds.
readIf: you like elegant, slow novels about hostages, music and unexpected intimacy.
skipIf: you want a taut hostage thriller with action and a fast pace.
